reference.notes: Exact BIC edge marginals on the chain and collider tables come from the retained stdlib enumeration conformance/bayesian/dag_posterior/reference.py (exact_marginals); the minimum masses are thresholds below them; no external oracle package.

oracle.historical_exposure: Written during this review from the fixture README's description of the 25-DAG BIC enumeration and the consuming test's SEM definitions; the in-test Rust enumeration was read to state the score convention. It reproduces the README's collider arrow mass 0.876.
oracle.project: stdlib exact-rational Gaussian-BIC enumeration of all three-node DAGs
oracle.method: exhaustive DAG enumeration with exact least-squares residuals; edge marginals under a uniform graph prior
oracle.independence_basis: The generator regenerates the chain (seed 7, n = 200) and collider (seed 11, n = 400) tables from the published SplitMix64 definition, enumerates all 25 three-node DAGs, scores each node by -(n/2) ln(RSS/n) - (|parents|/2) ln n with RSS from exact-Fraction normal equations on the stored doubles, and forms the edge marginals under a uniform DAG prior. It imports no Antecedent code and calls no posterior engine. The structural equations, sample sizes, seeds and the stream's seed offset and 53-bit mapping are the consuming test's statements, shared with the product input; the Gaussian-BIC score is a restated convention.
asserted_outputs: exact directed-edge marginals for the chain and collider tables (exact_marginals)
minimum-mass thresholds (consistency with the exact masses)
context_only_outputs: engine list, score family and exact_max_nodes (restated contract fields)

reference_review.scope: Chain and collider tables, 25 DAGs each; exact edge marginals compared with the exact engine at 1e-6 and with the test's own Rust enumeration at 1e-9.

reference_review.historical_exposure: Written during this review from the fixture README's description of the 25-DAG BIC enumeration and the consuming test's SEM definitions; the in-test Rust enumeration was read to state the score convention. It reproduces the README's collider arrow mass 0.876.
reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: Exact marginals exist only for the two static three-node tables; the sampling engines are checked against them within a Monte Carlo budget (0.06) by the test, and the CI-screened engine only on edges the full posterior keeps. The declared minimum masses (0.999, 0.8, 0.999) are thresholds set below the exact masses, and the DBN lag-1 mass has no exact reference here. The marginals describe the BIC posterior, not a calibrated posterior over true structures. Calibration unmeasured.

evidence_proposition: On known chain, collider and lag-1 series, every graph-posterior engine puts at least the declared minimum posterior mass on the generating skeleton, orientation or lag edge.
